model_annotations.Bulgarian: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy performance of six different methods across three benchmark datasets. The horizontal axis contains three categorical groups labeled "Mathverse," "MMLU," and "Physics," while the vertical axis represents "Accuracy (%)" on a linear scale ranging from approximately 50% to 62%, with tick marks at intervals of 2 percentage points. Within each benchmark group, six bars are displayed side by side, each corresponding to a different method as indicated by the legend: "DAPO+Self-reflection" (solid blue), "DAPO" (blue with diagonal hatching), "SRPO" (solid orange), "GRPO" (orange with diagonal hatching), "PPO+Self-reflection" (solid dark green), and "PPO" (green with diagonal hatching). For the Mathverse group, the bars show approximate values of 53.1% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 56.1% for DAPO, 53.5% for SRPO, 55.8% for SRPO-related GRPO, 53.3% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 54.5% for PPO. For the MMLU group, the approximate values are 55.8% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 57.0% for DAPO, 57.1% for SRPO, 56.0% for GRPO, 54.8% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 56.2% for PPO. For the Physics group, the values are notably higher overall, with approximately 57.5% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 58.1% for DAPO, 60.5% for SRPO, 61.0% for GRPO, 56.8% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 59.1% for PPO. The tallest bar in the chart appears in the Physics group for GRPO at roughly 61%, while the shortest bar is in the Mathverse group for DAPO+Self-reflection at approximately 53.1%. The bars are not sorted by value within each group but rather follow a consistent ordering by method across all three benchmarks. The use of hatching distinguishes the base methods (DAPO, GRPO, PPO) from their solid-colored counterparts, with solid fills used for the self-reflection variants and SRPO.
